steps.description: Logs in only if a login page appears; the OTP is typed in the terminal. Stores 'logged_in' or 'already_authenticated' in login_result so the post-login popup steps below only run after a real login.

steps.description: After the OTP Instagram shows 'Save your login info to Instagram?' (buttons: Save / Not now). within_text limits the click to that popup, so it can never hit a post's Save button on the feed behind it. Skipped if the popup does not appear.

selector.value: Save your login info to Instagram?

steps.description: Passes immediately if the popup never appeared.
Instagram may show 'Turn on notifications' (Turn On / Not Now) over the home page. Clicks Not Now inside that popup only; skipped if it does not appear.
Passes immediately if the popup never appeared.
The logged-in sidebar is showing.
The sidebar 'More' button (its icon is labelled 'Settings').
'Settings' entry in the More menu.
Instagram calls Accounts Center 'Meta Account'.
The Current/Past activity tabs only exist when earlier exports are listed, so wait for the always-present button.

steps.message: An export request is already pending (shown under 'Requested'). Nothing was submitted. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it on Instagram, then run again.
steps.description: Duplicate guard. The earlier-exports list loads after the dialog opens, so this waits up to 6s for the 'Requested' heading; if it appears the run stops cleanly before creating anything.
Matches the profile button ending in 'Instagram'; fails safely if you have several Instagram accounts.
Row on the review screen; its text also shows the current selection ('All available information').
Ends with exactly these boxes ticked and every other one cleared. Edit the list to change what is exported.
Let the date-range panel finish closing before moving on.
starts_with avoids also matching 'Customise information' (contains 'format').
Let the format panel finish closing; the checks below read the review screen behind it.
The review screen names the selected profile; it must contain WA_EXPECTED_ACCOUNT.
Handles 'For your security, please re-enter your password': types WA_IG_PASSWORD from .env and clicks Continue. Skipped if no prompt appears.
Instagram lists the new export under 'Requested' once it accepts the request. The long wait leaves time to finish any extra verification by hand in Chrome.

Downloads the newest finished export (latest 'Expires on') whose row mentions Followers and following + JSON into exports/downloads/. Sequence on Instagram: row Download -> 'Download your files' popup (click its Download) -> 're-enter your password' (typed from WA_IG_PASSWORD, Continue) -> zip downloads. A request just raised is still 'Requested', so this normally picks up an earlier finished export; if none is ready the run stops cleanly.

Reads followers_1.json straight from the zip (nothing is written to disk) and updates the wa_followers table: new followers are added with the current date/time, followers no longer in the list (unfollowed) are removed.
